description: This file defines utility types for safe handling of endianness conversions, encapsulating integer types with automatic conversions between host and network byte orders.

classes.name: Le16
classes.description: Class representing a 16-bit little-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.

classes.name: Le32
classes.description: Class representing a 32-bit little-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.

classes.name: Le64
classes.description: Class representing a 64-bit little-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.

classes.name: Be16
classes.description: Class representing a 16-bit big-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.

classes.name: Be32
classes.description: Class representing a 32-bit big-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.

classes.name: Be64
classes.description: Class representing a 64-bit big-endian unsigned integer, with automatic conversion to/from host byte order.
